data.one_liner: Offline-first PocketBase client using Drift for local caching
data.what_it_does: It extends the PocketBase SDK to cache all collections in a local SQLite database and automatically sync changes when connectivity is restored. The API mirrors PocketBase’s, but all reads can be served from the local store and writes are queued for later sync.
use_when: You need offline support for a PocketBase-backed app
You want reactive UI updates from local data changes
You want full-text search and complex local filtering without server round-trips
avoid_when: You only need a simple client with no offline requirements
Your app already uses another offline persistence layer
You need cross-platform support beyond Flutter (e.g., pure Dart)
strengths: Automatic offline sync and conflict handling
Reactive streams that update UI immediately
Full-text search and powerful local filtering
weaknesses: Adds Drift and SQLite dependencies, increasing bundle size
Only works with PocketBase, not other backends
Setup requires defining a Drift schema for each collection
data.setup_notes: Add pocketbase_drift to pubspec, initialize with $PocketBase.database, define a Drift schema for collections, run any necessary build steps for Drift (build_runner)
